title: Setback to an adjoining laneway or right-of-way that is not the primary street
text: C3.3.1 Buildings are set back from the street boundary in accordance with Table 3.3a. Table 3.3a Minimum setback of buildings from the street, adjoining laneway or right-of-way, where it is not the primary street to the dwelling: R2, R2.5, R5, R10 and R12.5 as per Secondary Street setbacks; R15-25, R30-35, R40 and R50-80 0.5m.

replaces.note: ROW treated as secondary street (1.5 m R15+, 1 m R40) -> 0.5 m
ROW not primary 0.5 m; communal street row no longer listed

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: R2-R12.5 take the secondary street value (merged cell confirmed on p29); R15+ 0.5 m. Communal streets are no longer separately listed.

verified.note: Merged cells confirmed on the page: 'As per Secondary Street setbacks' spans the R2 to R12.5 columns; 0.5m spans R15-25 to R50-80.
